## Featured Projects

### 1. Kanbex — Distributed Real-Time Kanban Platform
- **Category**: SaaS Productivity Platform
- **Live URL**: https://kanbex-frontend.onrender.com/
- **Stack**: React, Next.js, Node.js, PostgreSQL, Redis, Docker
- **Problem**: Traditional task managers struggle with lag and sync conflicts in fast-moving teams.
- **Architecture**:
  - Optimistic UI updates with instant drag-and-drop feedback.
  - Multi-user real-time state synchronization via WebSocket event streams.
  - Redis caching for hot workspace queries and session state.
  - Containerized with Docker and automated via GitHub Actions CI/CD.

### 2. Wizardry AI — AI SaaS Workflow & Visual Generation Platform

- **Problem**: Many generative AI wrappers lack proper state management, token streaming resilience, and visual workflow control.
- **Architecture**:

  - Tiered subscription billing and quota enforcement using Stripe.
